newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues new rules on foreign shipper taxes.
newsitem.headline: China issues new rules on foreign shipper taxes.

text.p: Beijing has issued new regulations aimed at tightening the supervision of taxes levied on foreign shipping companies operating out of China, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said on Tuesday.
The new rules would adjust tax regulations, increase transparency and clarify the legal positions of tax authorities, collection agencies and taxpayers, the newspaper said.
The rules would apply to the income generated by foreign shippers in China for international ocean services, it said.

They had been drawn up by the Ministry of Finance and the State General Administration of Taxation and had gone into effect on Monday after approval from the State Council, or cabinet, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
